annotations.title: Send a message to a company

description: Sends a message from the user to a Swiss firm through agentready.ch. The firm receives it by e-mail at once and replies to sender_email; a sent message cannot be withdrawn. Sends only with consent: true, the user's confirmation of the final text. intent is the kind of request. Returns status and next_step: sent, held_for_review, dry_run (with a preview, nothing sent), contact_not_available (the firm takes no messages), intent_not_allowed (with allowed_intents), consent_required, invalid_request (with invalid_fields) or not_found.

consent.description: true when the user read the final message and confirmed that it is sent.

dry_run.description: true: checks and previews only; nothing is sent.

intent.description: The kind of request: contact_request (general), request_quote (an offer), request_rate (rates or fees), request_callback, request_meeting or ask_question.

message.description: The message as the user approved it, sent word for word.

sender_email.description: The user's e-mail address; the firm replies there.

service_area.description: Optional. Where the service is needed.

slug.description: The firm's slug, as in its search result or profile link.

name: send_contact_request
